prompt: The last 3 order attempts on trade-execute returned 'tx failed' with no detailed error. What does risk-manage do?
expected_output: Halt condition #3 (CONSECUTIVE_TX_FAILURES >= 3) is triggered. halt=true, halt_reason=CONSECUTIVE_TX_FAILURES. No new orders until human resumes.

assertions.name: human_resume_only
assertions.description: Output must explicitly say only a human can resume
